notes: Evidence is (a) exact code file:line, and (b) real local read-only probes (FastAPI TestClient over web.app, anon HTTP GET, bounded pytest, local SQLite). External platform claims are marked EXTERNAL_UNVERIFIED when they cannot be proven from the repo/runtime. Fullscreen operations A (launch shell) / B (WebApp fullscreen API) / C (responsive CSS) are kept separate throughout.

findings.claim: The Direct L1 planner prompt key exists in runtime and UI code but is absent from the editable param registry, so it cannot be edited and reads back null from /api/config.
findings.evidence_ref: services/direct_chat_service.py:3641, services/direct_chat_service.py:7552, web/app.js:13439, services/param_catalog.py (grep 'direct_l1_planner' -> 0 matches)
findings.observed_result: grep for 'direct_l1_planner' in services/param_catalog.py returns no matches; the key is used at runtime (direct_chat_service.py:3641,7552) and displayed in UI stageCard (app.js:13439). No REGISTRY entry => GET /api/config yields null and there is no editing path (code default only).
findings.blocking_question: Owner: should prompts.direct_l1_planner_system_prompt become an editable registry/catalog key (with /api/config seed), or is read-only code default an accepted contract?

findings.claim: Only one of the three Direct prompts is reachable on the mod_direct tab screen; the library 'Open' lands on the synthesizer tab and mod_direct has no 'prompts' tab.

findings.blocking_question: Owner: is the two-door (module tab vs prompt library) model intended, or should mod_direct expose all three Direct prompt stages directly?

findings.claim: In PROMPTS_UI_V2 the prompts_verbilizer group card is deliberately skipped, so verbilizer modes are only reachable via module-card mode tabs or the fallback header dropdown.
findings.evidence_ref: web/index.html:2286-2293 (skip condition), web/index.html:2299-2332 (rendered content when not skipped)

findings.claim: Prompt library empty states are misleading: promptSections/promptVisibleItems do not apply isAdminIdHidden, and workspacePromptStale returns false on empty item lists so an empty list is shown without a reason.
findings.evidence_ref: web/app.js:14649-14795 (promptStageItems/promptSections/promptVisibleItems), web/app.js:18530 (isAdminIdHidden), web/index.html:2193-2199 (empty texts)
findings.observed_result: The hidden-admin filter (isAdminIdHidden) is applied elsewhere but not inside promptSections/promptVisibleItems; workspacePromptStale is false when item list is empty. index.html:2193 states 'Параметры этой вкладки ещё не загружены в базу (вкладка пустая)' and 2196 states 'Ничего не найдено по запросу ...' even when the search box is empty.
findings.blocking_question: Owner: should the empty-state distinguish 'no seed row', 'hidden by RBAC', and 'filtered out by search' instead of one misleading message?

findings.claim: On mobile (<768px) the top nav is exactly Status/Analytics/Modules plus 'More'; the AI/prompt-library entry lives only in the 'More' popover.

findings.claim: Operation A (launch shell): the mini app calls wa.ready() and wa.expand() at startup.
findings.evidence_ref: web/static/telegram-init.js:12 (wa.ready), web/static/telegram-init.js:13 (wa.expand)
findings.observed_result: telegram-init.js invokes Telegram.WebApp.ready() then .expand() during init; safe-area events are also wired here. This is the app-shell launch path, independent of the fullscreen API.

findings.claim: Operation B (WebApp fullscreen API): for platform 'tdesktop' the policy returns slot='hidden' with reason='tdesktop_disabled_until_e2e'; the launch 'expand' path does not drive fullscreen for tdesktop.
findings.evidence_ref: web/static/fullscreen-policy.js:32-40, 58-65, 77-92, 258-267
findings.observed_result: slotFromGeometry returns 'hidden' when platform==='tdesktop' (line 65); the capability branch sets reason='tdesktop_disabled_until_e2e' and slot='hidden' (lines 89-90). Writer adds class fs-hidden / data-fs-reason from these values (258-267). SDK methods exercised: requestFullscreen (+legacy requestFullScreen fallback), exitFullscreen, isFullscreen, onEvent/offEvent for fullscreenChanged/fullscreenFailed/viewportChanged/safeAreaChanged/contentSafeAreaChanged, viewportStableHeight, safeAreaInset, contentSafeAreaInset.
findings.blocking_question: Owner: is 'hidden' on tdesktop the accepted decision until a platform-specific e2e exists, or must tdesktop fullscreen be delivered (see SOUL12-04)?

findings.claim: Operation C (responsive CSS): the policy is geometry-driven and the CSS class writer is separate from the SDK calls, so fullscreen slot/class rendering can be verified locally without a real client.
findings.evidence_ref: web/static/fullscreen-policy.js:104-108 (slotFromGeometry decision), 258-267 (fs-hidden/fs-slot-* writer)
findings.observed_result: slot is derived from platform + content safe-area top + capability booleans; the writer toggles fs-slot-float / fs-hidden and data-fs-reason. This is the CSS/slot layer, distinct from A (launch shell) and B (SDK fullscreen API).

findings.claim: The initiative observer runs as a durable task_jobs kind 'initiative.observe' scheduled every 300s (288 ticks/day), NOT 25 jobs/day; the 25 figure is completed-job count from one 24h window.
findings.evidence_ref: services/memory_maintenance.py:335-342 (job registration), services/memory_maintenance.py:430-469 (_tick_initiative_observer), services/memory_maintenance.py (_INITIATIVE_OBSERVER_TICK_SECONDS=300), services/initiative_observer.py:913-1028
findings.observed_result: Code: tick interval is 300s => 288 scheduled ticks/day. w4-live-probes.md:16 reports job 'initiative.observe' completed 25x/24h in a live window - that is observed completions (coalesced), not the schedule.

findings.claim: The pipeline phases are scan -> evaluate -> diagnose with entry handle_initiative (existing) -> decision SAY/REACT/SILENT -> Direct L2 Writer -> SendRecheck -> send.
findings.evidence_ref: services/initiative_observer.py:581-871 (gates), 913-1028 (act), 1032-1043 (diagnose), 245-254 (default_counters)
findings.observed_result: Code structure matches: counters include passes, observed, eligible, scan_skipped, evals, opportunities, silent_decisions, intents_created, sent, react_decisions, writer_unavailable, eval_unavailable, errors, eval_skips{reason}. Phases and decision vocabulary confirmed in code.

findings.claim: Suppressors/skip codes are explicit and enumerable; master flag initiative_observer_enabled + K1 mca_gates.intents_enabled() (fail-closed), per-chat initiative.enabled for groups, plus profiles and eval budget.
findings.evidence_ref: services/initiative_observer.py:81-93 (skip codes), 104-127 (profiles), 245-254, 1035 (DIAG_MIN_OBSERVED)
findings.observed_result: Skip codes: chat_disabled, direct_address_seen, min_gap, day_cap, topic_cap, eval_budget, eval_not_due, not_enough_messages, context_duplicate, no_opportunity, semantic_parse_error, semantic_eval_unavailable. Profiles rare/normal/active: min_gap 2700-21600s, max_replies_per_day 2-12, eval_min_interval 1200-21600s, eval_min_messages 6-12, eval_llm_budget 4-24/day. Context hash TTL 12h; worker_budget.consume fail-open; LLM None => eval_unavailable. Diagnostic 'no opportunities 24h' requires observed>=DIAG_MIN_OBSERVED=20.

findings.claim: Embedding quota: the code has THREE (plus extra_N) credential slots each with its own quota group and rotation; the production journal shows primary->fallback_1->fallback_2 all 429 against one shared provider host (apinet.cloud) - a proxy-side cap, not our rotation.
findings.evidence_ref: services/embedding_control_plane.py:295-341 (_pick_credential: primary=keys.embedding_api_key/env EMBEDDING_API_KEY, fallback_1/2, extra_N; auto-group = alias or EMBEDDING_QUOTA_GROUP_LABELS), :656-678 (embedding_quota_state), :959 (cooling), :2035-2086; plans/.../w4-live-probes.md:41-54
findings.observed_result: Code confirms per-alias quota groups + cooldown skip + rotation (`_pick_credential` skips cooling groups and takes the next key). Live journal (w4-live-probes.md:46-51): 00:05:08 primary 429 -> 00:05:19 fallback_1 429 -> 00:05:28 fallback_2 429; all three go to the same host apinet.cloud (model gemini-embedding-001). Conclusion (documented, not assumed): three distinct keys/independent provider responses, but shared proxy cap on IP/upstream - do NOT claim 'three keys = three independent quotas'.
findings.blocking_question: Owner/provider: confirm the proxy (apinet.cloud) rate-limit/reset horizon for the shared upstream - the real reset horizon cannot be derived from the repo.

findings.claim: EMBEDDING_API_KEY is absent from the local .env; the primary embedding key is supplied by hot-config (keys.embedding_api_key), and a missing primary slot is not diagnosed (pool_rotation_diagnosis degenerate:False with 2 keys).
findings.evidence_ref: local .env probe (only LLM_API_KEY and EMBEDDING_FALLBACK_API_KEY present; EMBEDDING_API_KEY and EMBEDDING_BASE_URL absent), config/settings.py:374-375 (defaults empty/ apinet.cloud/v1), services/llm_client.py:434-436 (empty primary -> LLM_API_KEY), services/embedding_control_plane.py:295-341, w4-live-probes.md:52-54
findings.observed_result: Local .env: EMBEDDING_API_KEY has no entry (no secret printed); EMBEDDING_BASE_URL absent => default https://apinet.cloud/v1. Primary key therefore resolves from hot-config keys.embedding_api_key, else falls back to LLM_API_KEY. pool_rotation_diagnosis stays silent at degenerate:False when 2 keys remain, so loss of primary is not surfaced. This is a diagnostic/observability gap, not a rewrite trigger.
findings.blocking_question: Owner: accept a non-destructive WARN + explicit 'primary missing / degraded pool' state (no secret written to reports/code)?
